soft_start.rack_reference: Typical Eurorack module: 10-47 uF per rail; 20 modules x 22 uF = 0.44 mF per rail. S8.3 +/-12V rely on converter soft start; +5V also has U23 inrush control
soft_start.note: track_ramp_max_C / max_C are TOTAL capacitance (onboard + rack); rack_allowance subtracts the onboard bank at its high corner. Loads that draw less than the full target during start-up leave more room (no_load column). Bench item: -12V start-up into the real rack.

response_us.total_after_crossing: ~3 us + RC; then U5 off, rails decay

ov_guard.note: The bands are threshold screens, not a peak-voltage guarantee: opening U5 does not stop the energy already stored behind it (hs_short). The +5V band overlaps the TPS62933F OVP band (non-latching, stops the high side); either may act first on a slow excursion. A false trip latches every rail off (MAIN off, press RESET). Common-mode: both comparator inputs sit at ~1.24 V at a positive trip, inside VPD-2 V at full temperature (S8.3, >=15V qualified supply); -12V compares near 0 V.

ov_reference.earliest_rail_rise_ms: > 12 (TPS3808 open-CT POR minimum) + U5 ramp + converter soft start
ov_reference.stability: TLV431 is stable without a capacitor; 10u X5R (~9 uF at 1.24 V) is right of the oscillation region (~3 nF..1 uF at VKA = VREF, SLVS139Z Fig. 5-18; Fig. 5-19 phase margin ~25-40 deg at 0.4-1.5 mA)

S8_without_clamp.note: S8: R98 7.5k to V3V3, R99 47k to -12V, no clamp

ov_clamp.note: BAT54SL VF <= 0.24 V at 0.1 mA (25 C): U20 pin 9 stays above the -0.3 V input limit at room temperature (VF rises ~2 mV/C when cold); U20 is unpowered in this state, so its output state does not matter, only the input current (tens of uA, limit -50 mA). In normal operation the diode is reverse biased by 0.14 V and by ~0 V at the trip point, so its leakage does not move the threshold.

comparator_supply.supply: VPD before U5, after F1; D1 transient clamp
comparator_supply.note: Positive headroom during qualified operation. D1 rated clamp is NOT a measured ringing bound. Verify VPD spikes <36V at both comparator ICs; power loss/cold negative-input clamp remain gates.

disconnect.startup_thermal_note: Full constant 2.5 A from 0 V dissipates ~6.25 W average during a 25 ms ramp; startup foldback below 1.9 V and thermal shutdown may prevent start. No full-load capacitance rating; qualify actual load current vs voltage.
disconnect.latch: AUXOFF/FLT wire-AND with U18 on P5_OK. Existing filtered latch acts after ARMED. U20 watches raw OV even during startup. Brief OVLO-only events before ARMED or shorter than the bad-status filter can auto-recover. Do not call every event manually latched.
disconnect.qualification: No guaranteed <6V peak: 1.2us is typical only, parasitics/loop/DC bias uncertain; 6V is a screen, not a universal module rating. Do not connect valuable modules before fault tests.

fault_delay_sensitivity.model:
Screen, not an IC macromodel. Shorted U3 high side -> L2 -> raw bank/TVS ->
U23 Ron -> delivered bank (no load). U5 supplies its high current-limit corner
until U20 RC + assumed 2.6us logic/SHDN delay. No credit for U23 current limit
or short-circuit trip. Ideal reverse block. U23 opens after a chosen delay,
no intentional OVLO filter. Capacitance held constant, no wiring inductance,
TVS is 7V+0.05ohm, low-side body diode -0.7V, raw negative clamp -0.3V.
The separate post-interruption LC estimate covers selected local output-L.
This is NOT a maximum peak prediction or a guaranteed protection envelope.

input_budget.note: planning estimate; efficiencies are assumptions, not measurements

connectors.guidance: typical 2.54 mm IDC/ribbon contact ~1 A: use both headers above ~2 A per rail; unequal cable lengths/loads do not split equally

tvs.note: Above VRWM only at the stacked worst-case setpoint; <= ~5 mW even at 1 mA. Transient clamp only (not a 5 V limit): upstream overvoltage drives U20 -> FAULT -> U5 off; U23 isolates delivered +5V. D21 is on P5_RAW, not the headers. TVS transient rating depends on pulse duration and temperature; never infer a universal joule rating from peak watts.
